app_org: University of Lausanne - Swiss Elites project
app_topics: Swiss elites, political figures, historical persons, social networks, and prosopographical data
app_intro: A natural-language interface to the **Elites Suisses** knowledge graph of the [LESSH project](https://elites-suisses.lod4hss.org/) (Université de Lausanne / Universität Bern). Ask in English or French about Swiss political, economic, academic and military figures of the 19th–20th centuries: their mandates and memberships, studies, families and marriages.
example_questions: How many persons are in the database?
How many birth events are recorded?
Who are the recorded parents of a given person?
How many persons of each SDHSS class are there?
